notes: Pages opened (2 of 1-2): Pi (state), List of Zhou dynasty states. Wikidata id left null (unreachable). START -1046 is a bridge (confidence 1): the page's origin is legendary (c. 21st century BCE) and its Shang episodes are undated, so the state is drawn from the Zhou founding; the legendary earlier life is not drawn. END -418 follows the chu dossier's bound (the page dates the Chu annexation to no year; 418 is a Qi move into Xue's land). The page ties Pi to Xue (薛, Tengzhou), a separate state (List of Zhou dynasty states, second page opened: 'Xue (薛國) ... 298 BCE, Qi, Wei', Tengzhou) that has no Wikipedia article under the titles tried. 'Tan' on the Pi page is a neighbour to the north; by the researcher's reading the Tan 郯 of Tancheng (list: southwestern Tancheng County; the yue dossier's 414 gain), not the Tan 譚 of Jinan. AREA: none. No ruler list. NO WARS: the page has no dated campaign.
